newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ANZ workers on one-day strike - union.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ANZ workers on one-day strike - union.

text.p: Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd (ANZ) workers across New South Wales state voted on Friday to strike for the day to protest against planned job redundancies, a trade union official said.
"Two thousand people around New South Wales voted not to return to work for the entire day," Finance Sector Union (FSU) industrial officer Anna Burke told Reuters.

"We are in discussions with the bank at the moment, but if we can't reach some sort of resolution about that this evening, we will probably see rolling stoppages next week and action in other states as well," she added.
Workers voted to strike at stop-work meetings held in Sydney, Wollongong, Newcastle and on the state's central coast on Thursday morning.
ANZ staff in Canberra, also voted to strike for the day.
ANZ branches in Western Australia state were also closed on Friday due to a separate, planned one-day strike, Burke said.
Last month, the FSU said it feared the bank planned to shed as many as 5,000 jobs over the next six months as part of an efficiency drive.
ANZ has said it will reveal its position on staff numbers within a few months.
ANZ shares stood at A$7.45 at 0150 GMT, up 11 cents on Thursday's close.
